responsibility: Defines the user-visible and internal command-line options for the V850 backend and the generated option variables they feed. It introduces CPU-selection switches, ABI selection, floating-point, call and jump model controls, loop and prologue features, alignment and relaxation flags, and the msda/mtda/mzda small-memory size thresholds backed by shared option storage, forming the option table that drives V850 target_flags and backend policy.
same_name_distinction: The option-definition file for the V850 port: unlike v850.cc's backend implementation code, v850.h's target macros/configuration, or v850.md's RTL instruction descriptions, this file is the declarative source of V850-specific -m switches and generated option variables such as CPU selection, ABI mode, floating-point control, call/jump behavior, and SDA/TDA/ZDA size settings.
